short: Choose the twist scale as a power of two

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.PageN
lean.plain: Choose the twist scale as a power of two
lean.note: At each scale $x$, the cyclotomic-layer parameter $2^{e_2}$ must lie between $x^{2+8\varepsilon}$ and twice that value. The exponent $e_2$ can therefore vary with $x$ while the auxiliary primes are fixed for the window.
